question: Where would a hero go after drinking in the paśupāna rite?
premises: In the paśupāna rite one drinks
Even a hero would go to hell
inference: Drinking in the paśupāna rite leads even a hero to hell.
uncertainties: Whether pītvā refers to ritual drinking generally
plain_english: Having drunk in the paśupāna rite, even a hero would go to hell.
